title: Do-not-use advisory
tldr: Do not drink or use tap water for any purpose while a do-not-use advisory is in effect. Avoid contact with skin, eyes and lungs. Use commercially bottled or officially approved alternatives and follow local instructions for sanitation.
steps: Do not bathe, wash dishes or use connected water and ice appliances.
Check official water distribution and hygiene arrangements.
Tell everyone in the household and keep children and pets from using taps.
Wait for the official all-clear and complete any required flushing or appliance instructions.
next: Plan temporary access to safe washing and sanitation if restrictions continue.
watch: Boiling does not override a do-not-use order.
